item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 30/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring one or two rain patches to the region. With the easterly airstream moderating gradually, it will be relatively humid over the coastal areas midweek this week, and it will be warm during the day. Another easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China towards the weekend. In early next week, a trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China. Besides, the northeast monsoon will affect southern China midweek next week.
